Maria G: quick handoff — I'm primary for the next 8h (taking over from Tess). TL;DR: observed a spike of 5xxs on /v1/generate between 03:10–03:18 UTC affecting a small percentage of Hosted customers. Auto-fallback triggered to quantized-v1, which kept latency ok but increased token cost slightly. No active SEV, but keep an eye for regression alerts and customer support noise.

Maria G: Coverage & roles — Primary: Maria G, Secondary: Raj P. If I'm paged and can't respond within 7m, escalate to Raj. Shadow/SRE on call: Simon L (12:00–16:00 UTC). Tess will be offline after today 09:00 PT.

Maria G: Known gaps right now —
• No one with dedicated access to the EU-dedicated pool for cross-region failover (manual ops) — we have runbook but keys are with infra team.
• Canary routing rule for v2->v2-quant is not fully automated (manual flip only).

Maria G: Runbook quick links (copy/paste):
• Latency/5xx triage: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-5xx
• KV cache fallback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback
• Model rollout rollback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollbacks

Maria G: Useful commands (run from staging or ops jump-host):
```bash
# check recent 5xxs and sample traces
rg "status=5.." /var/log/proxy/*.log | tail -n 200
# quick query to prometheus for the last 20m
promql "sum(rate(http_requests_total{route=\"/v1/generate\",status=~\"5..\"}[20m])) by (region)"
# restart workers in a single pool (careful, one AZ at a time)
opsctl restart pool gpu-pool-eu-1 --leader-only
```

Maria G: Temporary mitigations I applied before handoff —
• Re-routed 8% of traffic from EU to US pool to reduce queueing in EU (manual).
• Increased prefix caching TTL on the heavy customer to 60s.

Oncall Bot: Pager summary: 03:12 UTC — 5xx_spike /v1/generate (alerts suppressed after auto-fallback). Pager link: https://redwood.internal/pagers/INC-2026-4551

Raj P: noted, thanks. I'll be reachable by DM/phone. If the 5xx rate rises >2x baseline re-open the rollback playbook and notify support.

Simon L: Added a quick dashboard link to the thread — https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/latent-5xx?from=now-30m&to=now. Will watch error budget and token cost delta.

Tess (SRE): Left a couple of comments in the runbook — added the `opsctl` step for leader-only restarts and a note about automating canary flip. Also flagged an infra ticket for EU pool key access: INF-1283.

Maria G: Escalation matrix (short):
• SEV start -> primary declares, if network-level (LB/region) escalate to Eng-Infra (pager group infra-p1).
• Model-quality regression -> notify Research + Product (they get immediate channel alert).

Maria G: What to watch in next 2h —
• 5xx trend on /v1/generate (promql above).
• Request latencies for the affected customer cohort (prefix ID: cust_0x9fa).
• Support tickets (tagging 'realtime-generate').

Raj P: If you want, I can stand up a temporary rate-limit for that tenant (low risk) — runbook snippet below.
```yaml
# temporary tenant throttle
tenants:
  cust_0x9fa:
    max_qps: 5
    enforce: true
```

Maria G: Good idea, keep it as last-resort. Also: if you do a tenant throttle, let support know and annotate the ticket with `#ops-throttle`.

deploy-bot: @channel Deployment detected: canary/v2 -> v2-quant flip scheduled in 2h (dry-run). CI: green. If anyone objects to the flip, raise now.

Maria G: Objection: canary flip should wait until we stabilise the error rate for 30m. If it still looks good at 05:15 UTC, we can proceed.

Simon L: +1 to waiting. We should also confirm the automated fallback logic triggers for the canary variant before flip.

Raj P: I'll monitor and can manually abort flip if lead signals. Phone: +1-555-0102.

Maria G: OK — summary actions before I go offline to lunch (10:10 PT):
• Raj: standby as secondary, ready to throttle tenant if error rate spikes.
• Simon: hold viz and confirm fallback test passes.
• Tess: follow up on INF-1283 for EU-pool access.
• Everyone: don't flip the canary until 05:15 UTC and we have 30m of stable metrics.

Maria G: Closing note — I pasted the short checklist into the incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-4551/checklist. Ping here if anything urgent. :thumbsup:

Raj P: Acknowledged.

Tess (SRE): acknowledged, thanks for the handoff.
